title: Rightward Catalog Transfer
statement: Given a positive number $k$ of work tapes, a source tape and a destination tape, a finite word $w$, a configuration in the sweep, rewind, or done phase, and a natural number $r$, the resulting configuration is obtained from the catalog copy operation and has every source-tape cell with index from the source head position plus $r$ up to, but not including, the source head position plus the length of $w$ left blank.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes
A source and a destination work tape
A finite word over the tape alphabet
A configuration in one of the three sweep phases
caveat: The definition of the underlying catalog copy operation is not included, so its effects on the other configuration fields and tapes cannot be specified.
